title: Implement fail-closed AgentOS soft-update validation core
goal: Strengthen the existing AgentUpdateManager so AgentOS definition updates reject untrusted manifests, unsafe paths, incompatible revisions, unexpected files, and local edit conflicts before activation.
context: Issue #432 builds on the existing update transaction boundary. This task is limited to portable Swift runtime policy and regression tests; network transport and SwiftUI integration are separate follow-up work.
forbidden_changes: Do not load or execute downloaded native code.
Do not change App UI, Xcode project, entitlements, provider credentials, or unrelated modules.
Do not claim download or filesystem activation is implemented by this policy-only manager.
acceptance_criteria: Manifest decoding rejects malformed or hard-update manifests.
Only bounded Markdown, JSON, and text files in approved AgentOS roots are accepted.
Repository, base revision, checksum, staged file set, and local edit conflicts are validated before snapshot and activation.
Regression tests cover traversal, executable files, duplicate paths, bad manifests, repository/base mismatch, conflicts, and unexpected files.
verification: CI workflow results for the commit
recovery: Revert this single commit if package compilation or transaction-boundary tests regress.
